text.p: Oakley Inc said Monday its board of directors has okayed the repurchase of up to 3.0 million shares of company common stock from time to time in the open market.
Currently the company has about 71.4 million common shares outstanding.

"In spite of recent activity in our stock, we are confident there has been no change in the fundamentals of our business, and we look forward to future opportunities," Chief Executive Officer Mike Parnell said in a statement.

"The decision to initiate a repurchase program was made after reviewing the company's cash position and assessing the current share price, which we believe represents an attractive investment opportunity."
Oakley shares were up 1/4 at 15-1/4 by midday.

In recent weeks, Oakley shares have come under pressure in financial markets over concern the rapid growth of sales of sunglasses is slowing. The concern was sparked by retailer Sunglass Hut International Inc's warning on October 10 of disappointing third quarter results.
